text:
Devon M: quick sync on KiteLabs private roll — they're blocked on artifacts getting into the airgapped staging cluster. saw errors on the sync job: `403` from our artifact mirror.
Priya R: ok what's the exact failure? link to logs?
Devon M: paste of logs — `puller: failed to GET https://mirror.redwood-cdn/internal/kite/1234: 403` — customer says their edge NAT only allows specific egress IPs, might be dropping signed URL requests.
Alex G: probable that signed URLs use hostnames that require SNI; NetOps set NAT gw to inspect TLS? @NetOps CJ any idea on SNI passthrough for that tenant?
NetOps CJ: we have a rule for hostname inspection on their VRF. can open a temporary bypass for the artifact mirror IPs. need exact IPs + window.
Devon M: thanks — mirror IPs: 34.199.12.8, 34.199.12.9. prefer a 2h window tomorrow 03:00-05:00 UTC for a controlled resync.
Priya R: who owns the egress prober? we should validate connectivity before opening NAT changes.
Maria S: I built the prober script but not the ownership handoff. `prober/kite_probe.sh` lives in infra repo. I can run quick smoke from a staging host, but someone with NAT privileges needs to run from customer-side when window opens.
Devon M: ok so ownership split: Maria runs smoke, NetOps sets bypass, Alex to coordinate with customer ops for scheduling. @Alex G can you confirm with customer?
Alex G: pinged their ops lead (KiteOps: @suzanne). waiting on ETA. also FYI deploy-bot shows a private-config change queued for 03:30 but unsynced artifacts will fail canary.
deploy-bot: buildkite:kite/private-config#432 queued by alexg — will try to deploy at 2026-04-12T03:30:00Z
Devon M: if customer can't open NAT window, fallback is to use signed SFTP pull via jump host into their DMZ — that's slower but doable. need decision by EOD PST.
NetOps CJ: I can do the bypass but need a ticket and approval. I'll create infra-ticket/NET-927 and tag security for signoff.
Priya R: also flagging cert rotation: cert used to sign artifacts expires in 8 days. if we need to re-sign older artifacts post-rotation we should plan cadence. who owns cert rotation ops? @Maria S or security?
Maria S: security owns CA key, but I can coordinate re-signing script. will prepare a runbook.
Devon M: great. action items: 1) Alex confirm schedule with customer (owner: Alex). 2) NetOps open ticket + do bypass (owner: NetOps CJ). 3) Maria prepare prober smoke and re-sign runbook (owner: Maria). 4) Priya coordinate canary gating and update deploy-bot triggers (owner: Priya). I'll follow up in the morning with a short status update.
Alex G: ack. I'll update here once Suzanne replies.
Maria S: prepping prober now, will post results in this thread.
NetOps CJ: created NET-927 and looped security. link: https://internal.redwood/infra/tickets/NET-927
Devon M: thanks all :thumbsup:
